snippet.title: Mercenary - Novagen (atari st)
snippet.description:
Object of the game is to escape from Targ. You need a lot of money to hire a new ship. To make money, you have to pick up some items located in the underground rooms and bring them back to the Colony Craft that orbit at 65.00 above the city..

(cpu:standard)

ps:messed up somewhere with the quality, sorry about that
